page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.g5ne.8xlarge is a general-purpose virtual instance powered by a 2.5 GHz Intel Xeon 8163 processor built on the x86_64 architecture. Managed via the KVM hypervisor, this instance provides 32 dedicated vCPUs mapped across 16 physical cores with simultaneous multithreading. It features 128 GB of system memory, yielding a 1:4 vCPU-to-RAM ratio of 4.0 GB of memory per vCPU. Hardware acceleration includes AVX and AVX-512 instruction set extensions along with AES cryptographic hardware support. The instance lacks local ephemeral storage and dedicated GPU hardware, relying instead on network-attached storage solutions, and offers a baseline network bandwidth of 15 Gbps.

Benchmark data demonstrates a distinct divergence between single-core and multi-core capabilities. Single-core performance registers in the bottom quartile, as indicated by a Geekbench single-core score of 951.0 and a stress-ng single-core result of 1106.88. Single-threaded tasks like gzip compression show poor throughput. Conversely, multi-core workload results align with average industry baselines, reflected in a stress-ng multi-core score of 23406.46, a Geekbench multi-core score of 8312.0, and a PassMark CPU score of 23344.34. Memory throughput shows mixed characteristics: cached memory read bandwidth reaches 1306.09 GB/sec and uncached read bandwidth measures 119.7 GB/sec, though the overall PassMark memory score falls in the lower quartile.

From a resource allocation and cost efficiency perspective, the instance delivers balanced compute-to-memory density without the price overhead of integrated NVMe storage or specialized accelerator hardware. Mid-range performance metrics across database operations, static web serving at 14.04 GB/sec, and Redis SET operations at 23.48 million operations per second indicate suitability for distributed enterprise applications, software compilation pipelines, web server fleets, and moderate database workloads. However, the lower single-threaded efficiency makes it less suitable for latency-sensitive single-core execution.
description: Alibaba Cloud ecs.g5ne.8xlarge is a general-purpose KVM virtual instance featuring 32 vCPUs and 128 GB of system RAM, providing 4.0 GB per core. Driven by an Intel Xeon 8163 processor running at 2.5 GHz, the x86_64 architecture includes 16 physical cores with hyper-threading and supports AVX-512 and AES instructions. The server includes no local disk storage or GPU accelerators, relying on external network storage alongside a baseline network bandwidth of 15 Gbps. Benchmark results show average multi-core CPU performance, software compilation capability, static web serving throughput of 14.04 GB/sec, and Redis execution speeds reaching 23.48 million operations per second. However, single-core processing power and single-threaded gzip compression remain in the lower performance brackets. This resource balance provides a cost-conscious infrastructure choice for multi-threaded applications, enterprise backend services, web hosting fleets, and moderate database operations that do not depend on high single-threaded clock speed.
